target.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "host_uplink" and (r._field == "previous" or r._field == "interface" or r._field == "kind")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.previous) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, text: "Uplink " + r.previous + " → " + (if r.interface == "" then "none" else r.interface + " (" + r.kind + ")"), tags: "uplink"}))

from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_resolver" and (r._field == "previous" or r._field == "owner")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "path"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.previous) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, text: "Resolver via " + r.path + ": " + r.previous + " → " + r.owner, tags: "resolver"}))

title: Smoking Pi – Overview
description: The landing page: where the Pi is connected (uplink, Wi-Fi, public address, network, approximate place, resolver), how the link is doing right now and over the selected range, the targets that need a look, and links to the detailed dashboards.

links.title: Target detail
links.tooltip: Every layer measured for this target (ICMP, TCP, HTTP by version, DNS) on one page

panels.title: Uplink
panels.description: The interface every measurement leaves through (wifi_link.py, host_uplink).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "host_uplink" and (r._field == "interface" or r._field == "kind")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.interface == "" then "no route" else r.interface + " (" + r.kind + ")"})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Wi-Fi network (SSID)
panels.description: The network the Pi is associated to. Empty on a wired Pi.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "wifi_link" and r._field == "associated") |> group() |> last() |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.ssid})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Public address (IPv4)
panels.description: The address the Internet sees, from Google's authoritative DNS (public_ip.py).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv4" and (r._field == "ip" or r._field == "asn" or r._field == "owner" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.ip})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Network (ISP)
panels.description: The network (AS) announcing the public address, from Team Cymru.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv4" and (r._field == "ip" or r._field == "asn" or r._field == "owner" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.owner != "") |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: "AS" + string(v: r.asn) + " " + r.owner})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Approximate location
panels.description: Geolocation BY ADDRESS, from ipinfo.io: often the ISP's point of presence, never the house. Off with PUBLIC_IP_GEO=0.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv4" and (r._field == "ip" or r._field == "asn" or r._field == "owner" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.country != "") |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.city + ", " + r.region + ", " + r.country})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: DNS answered by
panels.description: Who resolves for the house through the router (resolver_identity.py; docs/public-resolver.md).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "dns_resolver" and r.path == "router" and r._field == "owner") |> last() |> group() |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Public IPv6
panels.description: Absent when the house has no IPv6 route.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv6" and r._field == "ip") |> last() |> group() |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: DNS wizard targets not answering
panels.description: Adopted from the DNS wizard, losing probes now. Usually a CDN that drops ICMP rather than an outage: pause them from the Targets page, or measure the service over HTTP or TCP instead.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "loss") |> group(columns:["_measurement","target","category"]) |> last() |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.category == "dns_wizard" and r._value > 0.0) |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Targets answering, by layer
panels.description: Targets with a measurement in the last 15 minutes, per layer. The welcome tour and the Targets page say what each layer tells you.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"ICMP ping"}) |> keep(columns:["ICMP ping"])

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "dns_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"DNS resolution"}) |> keep(columns:["DNS resolution"])

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "tcp_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"TCP handshake"}) |> keep(columns:["TCP handshake"])

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "http_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"HTTP/1.1–3"}) |> keep(columns:["HTTP/1.1–3"])

panels.title: Losing packets
panels.description: Targets whose last measurement lost at least one probe, all layers. The DNS wizard's targets are left out, as in alerting: many CDNs drop ICMP (see the next panel).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "loss") |> group(columns:["_measurement","target","category"]) |> last() |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.category != "dns_wizard" and r._value > 0.0) |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Wi-Fi signal
panels.description: Received signal strength at the Pi (wifi_link). Above -67 dBm is comfortable for real-time traffic, below -75 dBm expect retries. Empty on a wired Pi.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "wifi_link" and r._field == "signal_dbm") |> group() |> last() |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: ISP gateway latency
panels.description: Median round trip to the first hop past the home router that answers, in the last probe window, IPv4 (cpe_latency, milliseconds). CPE discovery skips hop 1, so this is usually the ISP's gateway; behind a mesh node or a second router it can still be in the house. Loss is left out on purpose: gateways rate-limit ICMP, so some loss is normal (see CPE microcuts).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "cpe_latency" and r.protocol == "ipv4" and r._field == "median") |> group() |> last() |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Measurements (1 h)
panels.description: Measurement rounds written in the last hour, all layers (each is several probes).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: ICMP latency by category, median across targets
panels.description: The median of every target's median ping in each window, per category (latency, seconds). One line per kind of destination: a jump in one line is that kind of destination; a jump in all of them is the house or the ISP. The DNS wizard's targets are left out.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "latency" and r._field == "median" and r.category != "dns_wizard") |> map(fn:(r) => ({r with category: if r.category == "topsites" then "Top sites" else if r.category == "netflix" then "Netflix OCA" else if r.category == "dns" then "DNS resolvers" else if r.category == "custom" then "Custom" else if r.category == "cpe" then "ISP gateway" else if r.category == "unknown" then "Uncategorized" else r.category})) |> group(columns:["category"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: ICMP loss by category, mean across targets
panels.description: Share of pings lost, averaged over the category's targets in each window (latency, 0-1). A short spike in every category at once is the link; one category alone is its destinations. The DNS wizard's targets are left out: many CDNs drop ICMP.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "latency" and r._field == "loss" and r.category != "dns_wizard") |> map(fn:(r) => ({r with category: if r.category == "topsites" then "Top sites" else if r.category == "netflix" then "Netflix OCA" else if r.category == "dns" then "DNS resolvers" else if r.category == "custom" then "Custom" else if r.category == "cpe" then "ISP gateway" else if r.category == "unknown" then "Uncategorized" else r.category})) |> group(columns:["category"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Toward the ISP: gateway latency and Wi-Fi signal
panels.description: The two stretches between the Pi and the Internet. ISP gateway latency (cpe_latency, ms, left axis) rising with the Wi-Fi signal (dBm, right axis) falling points at the radio; gateway latency rising on a steady signal points at the home router, the access line or the ISP's edge.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "cpe_latency" and r._field == "median") |> group(columns:["protocol"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: "gateway " + r.protocol})) |> group(columns:["series"])

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "wifi_link" and r._field == "signal_dbm") |> group() |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: "Wi-Fi signal"})) |> group(columns:["series"])

panels.title: ISP gateway cut windows
panels.description: 10-second ISP gateway probe windows that lost more than half their pings in the selected range: the raw material of a microcut (common/microcuts.py; 50% is MICROCUT_LOSS_PCT's default). The gateway's rate-limit floor stays below it. Details: CPE microcuts.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "cpe_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r._value > 50.0) |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Wi-Fi drops
panels.description: Times the Wi-Fi link lost carrier in the selected range (wifi_link carrier_down_count). Each one is a disconnect, however short.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "wifi_link" and r._field == "carrier_down_count") |> group(columns:["interface"]) |> increase() |> last() |> group() |> sum() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Uplink changes
panels.description: Times the interface the Pi measures through changed in the selected range (host_uplink). Marked on the charts as "Uplink changed".

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "host_uplink" and r._field == "previous") |> group() |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Router resolver changes
panels.description: Times the network answering the house's DNS through the router changed in the selected range (dns_resolver). The "Resolver changed" marks on the charts also include the Pi's own DNS observer.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "dns_resolver" and r.path == "router" and r._field == "previous") |> group() |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Targets that need a look (last 15 minutes)
Most loss first, then slowest against their own usual
panels.description: Every measured target and layer from its last measurement in the last 15 minutes: the lossiest first, then the ones furthest above their own usual (the median of their medians over the last 24 hours). Comparing a target with itself is what makes an HTTP fetch and a ping sortable together. Click a target for every layer on one page. The DNS wizard's targets are left out.

targets.query:
import "join"
now = from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and (r._field == "loss" or r._field == "median") and r.category != "dns_wizard") |> group(columns:["_measurement","target","_field"]) |> sort(columns:["_time"]) |> last() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey:["_measurement","target"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
usual = from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-24h) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "median" and r.category != "dns_wizard") |> group(columns:["_measurement","target"]) |> median() |> group() |> keep(columns:["_measurement","target","_value"])
join.left(left: now, right: usual, on: (l, r) => l._measurement == r._measurement and l.target == r.target, as: (l, r) => ({Target: l.target, Layer: if l._measurement == "latency" then "ICMP" else if l._measurement == "dns_latency" then "DNS" else if l._measurement == "tcp_latency" then "TCP" else "HTTP", Loss: l.loss, Median: l.median, Usual: r._value, Ratio: if exists l.median and exists r._value and r._value > 0.0 then l.median / r._value else -1.0})) |> sort(columns:["Loss","Ratio"], desc:true) |> limit(n:15)

panels.title: Probe traffic against the budget (MB/day)
panels.description: What the configured SmokePing measurements cost a day, per probe, stacked (decimal MB, both directions, from the per-sample costs in docs/measurement-budget.md). The dashed line is the ceiling, MEASUREMENT_BUDGET_MB_PER_DAY. The configured cost, not metered traffic: a step means targets or cadence changed.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "measurement_budget_probe" and r._field == "mb_per_day") |> group(columns:["probe"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "measurement_budget" and r._field == "ceiling_mb_per_day") |> group() |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Samples per hour against the budget
panels.description: Measurements SmokePing runs an hour, per probe, stacked (targets × pings × 3600 / step). The dashed line is the ceiling, MEASUREMENT_BUDGET_SAMPLES_PER_HOUR.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "measurement_budget_probe" and r._field == "samples_per_hour") |> group(columns:["probe"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "measurement_budget" and r._field == "ceiling_samples_per_hour") |> group() |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Bandwidth budget used
panels.description: Share of MEASUREMENT_BUDGET_MB_PER_DAY the configured measurements use. Yellow from 75%, red over the ceiling; `sudo smoking-pi budget` lists what to cut, most expensive first.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "measurement_budget" and r._field == "bandwidth_pct") |> group() |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Sample budget used
panels.description: Share of MEASUREMENT_BUDGET_SAMPLES_PER_HOUR the configured measurements use. Yellow from 75%, red over the ceiling.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "measurement_budget" and r._field == "samples_pct") |> group() |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

options.content:

- [SmokePing Latency & Loss](/d/smokeping-lat-pct-v28)

- [HTTP by version](/d/http-by-version-v1)
- [DNS resolvers](/d/dns-resolvers-v1)
- [Wi-Fi link](/d/wifi-link-v1)
- [CPE microcuts](/d/cpe-microcut-v1)
